_comment: Reviewed non-matches for the `radius` family in vocabulary.ts's RETIRED scan. RETIRED.radius flags bare `rounded`/`rounded-<side>` (Tailwind's static 0.25rem default, with no rung suffix) so it can find real Tailwind class strings — but that same rule cannot tell a class string apart from the ordinary English word "rounded" in a comment, a JSDoc line, or a local identifier like `const rounded = Math.round(...)`. Every entry below was read in its surrounding context and confirmed to be one of those, never a radius utility. This is the same reviewed-baseline ratchet as the sibling `border-baseline.json` (see that file for the border family) — kept as its own file rather than nested under one shared key because `readBaseline()` in scan-hardcoded-values.mjs hard-validates `{ violations: string[] }`, a flat array, so a second family cannot live inside the same `violations` array without changing a validator another script also depends on. This baseline must only shrink: fixing the scanner to correctly exclude a shape removes entries here, and any new source hit that isn't already the exact text of an existing entry is a real, unswept site — never add an entry to hide one, and never reword or rename working source just to make an entry unnecessary. Hand-maintained by design: no `--update-baseline` regeneration path — every addition here should come from someone reading the line in context and confirming it isn't a class string.
